persona.name: Cole Brandt

occupation.title: College Student / Cross-Country Walk-On
occupation.organization: Appalachian State University, sophomore studying exercise science
occupation.description: Walk-on to the cross-country roster, fighting for a travel spot every season. Works ten hours a week at the campus rec center desk and shops for shoes the way he budgets everything: last season's model, one size run wide, discount code stacked.

persona.education: Sophomore B.S. candidate in exercise science at Appalachian State; public high school in Hickory, NC where he ran his 5K PR of 16:12.
long_term_goals: Crack the travel squad top seven
Graduate with no debt he can't outrun
persona.style: Earnest and a little intense, talks fast when the subject is running and barely at all otherwise. Quotes his coach and lettsrun threads interchangeably. Every purchase is a spreadsheet decision — he knows the retail price, the outlet price, and the resale price of every trainer in his rotation, and he will tell you the price-per-mile unprompted.

traits: Shy off the topic of running
Prone to comparing himself to teammates

interests: Shoe release calendars and price tracking
Trail runs on the Blue Ridge Parkway
likes: Durable outsoles that survive gravel roads
Team gear he didn't pay for
dislikes: Rich kids with four pairs of race shoes

beliefs: The shoe matters less than the work, but the right shoe at the right price matters
You can outwork a talent gap
skills: Fixing his own bike and most of his roommates' problems

general: Runs 60-70 miles a week in exactly two rotated pairs
Tracks every pair's mileage in the notes app to the mile
Waits for models to go on clearance before replacing
Test-wears teammates' shoes on easy days before considering a model

morning: 6 am team run or solo doubles
workday: Classes, library, rec center desk shift
evening: Team dinner at the dining hall
Film or stats homework, asleep by 10:30
weekend: Sunday laundry, meal prep, letsrun rabbit holes

health.physical: Lean and durable so far; one bout of Achilles tendinitis last spring that scared him into actually doing his calf raises.
health.mental: Motivated but anxious about his roster spot; ties too much self-worth to workout splits and knows it.

relationships.name: Coach Weller
relationships.description: Tough but fair; told Cole 'walk-ons who last become coaches' and Cole has been chewing on that for a year.

relationships.name: Trent
relationships.description: A scholarship runner with a shoe deal hookup; Cole borrows his castoffs and pretends it's not a big deal.
